# _obs and _want before ck3xbl_st_gain_next_value reads them. The pulse runs after the day's damage (seen in game).
# Damage days left from tomorrow up to E - 1 (the plan finishes the day before E, day E is a reserve), at least 1.

# Kills wanted per day: what is left of the target over the days left.

	value = var:ck3xbl_st_target
	subtract = num_enemies_killed
	min = 0
	divide = ck3xbl_st_days_left_value
}
# The next gain: 0.05 once the target is reached. The first day with kills after a (re)seed ran natively at gain 1 with the
# levers off, so its kills set the gain absolutely (want / obs, ck3xbl_st_measured = 0); after that the closed loop on the
# observed kills (damped 0.7, one step within [0.25, 4]) absorbs rolls, advantage and the owners' own modifiers.
ck3xbl_st_gain_next_value = {
	value = var:ck3xbl_st_gain
	if = { limit = { scope:ck3xbl_st_rem <= 0 } value = 0.05 }
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:ck3xbl_st_obs >= 1 var:ck3xbl_st_measured = 1 }
		multiply = { value = scope:ck3xbl_st_want divide = scope:ck3xbl_st_obs subtract = 1 multiply = 0.7 add = 1 min = 0.25 max = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:ck3xbl_st_obs >= 1 }
		value = { value = scope:ck3xbl_st_want divide = scope:ck3xbl_st_obs }
	}
	min = 0.05
	max = 33
}
